cues: One is coated with zinc, galvanised, like the jasta roofing sheet on houses all over the hills.
The other is coated with tin, like the inside of a food can.
Both coatings keep air and water away from the iron.
text: Two pieces of iron sheet. One is coated with zinc, galvanised, like the jasta roofing sheet on houses all over the hills. The other is coated with tin, like the inside of a food can. Both coatings keep air and water away from the iron.
